decision: Qualify the combined compiler build strategy: complete source-to-executable improves 8.22% in both blocks with every program/executable byte identical. Frontend and memory regressions remain. No compiler source transformation or sub-ten-second result is claimed.

native_cohort.scope: Eight serial complete fresh source-to-executable compiles with the fixed adapter cached; same61programflags plus two workers in both subjects, frozen aaef source; standard unprofiled compiler versus native-CPU plus PGO compiler. Measures the combined strategy; no independent additive CPU/PGO gain is claimed. Separate from the eight source-to-Object primary runs and preliminary pilots.

scope: Frozen aaef source includes the retained frontend changes and real worker scheduler. Four compiler-tool builds use nightly2026-03-03, explicit aarch64-apple-darwin, compiler profile ThinLTO/CGU1, four Cargo jobs, incremental0 and warnings-as-errors. Standard control has no target-cpu override; other modes add target-cpu=native. Generate/use have absolute profile paths. Build and training time are excluded from program timings.

Eight training programs reproduce unprofiled outputs;14 paired fixtures and56 balanced held-out compiles preserve all source/bytecode/Object/complete metadata. Every complete Deflate executable remains identical. No scalar retirement, grammar/language change, weaker proof or new program-runtime campaign is claimed.

Eight serial ABBA/BAAB source-to-Object runs and eight separate complete executable builds use the same61programflags plus2workers in both subjects. No concurrent heavy build/test/sample/hash/archive work runs during primary cohorts. Fixed runtime/entry adapter objects are pinned and cached; source compilation is fresh.

Both complete-build blocks improve about8.2%. Object process time/instructions also improve. Frontend time and memory are adverse, and native-link time rises observationally. Every observation, screen and per-case/block result remains; no tiny-program pooled percentage or unrelated-phase causal attribution is claimed.

Profile use reports18607 functions without training data and no hash/control-flow mismatch diagnostics. All warnings remain in the build JSON log. Both standard/native-CPU initial output and executable gates pass; those screens establish no independent CPU-only speedup.

The initial read-only hardware metadata query is denied by the default sandbox after source/Rust configuration capture. No build or test runs in that failed setup. Its script/logs/source-state remain; remaining metadata is resumed with scoped command approval, reusing the immutable snapshot.

Raw/merged profiles, exact scripts and their derivation, every build/training/timing log, source configuration/harness, fixture/program/executable bytes and native linker inputs are included. Compiler binaries and intermediates are excluded/SHA-pinned; unchanged compiler source is pinned by Git revision. Pure replay validates saved evidence without rerunning compilation or timing. Complete compilation below ten seconds remains open.

setup_first_attempt.error: Default sandbox denied sysctl CPU model read. No compiler builds, training or tests ran.
setup_first_attempt.next: Resume only remaining read-only metadata with scoped command approval; keep completed immutable source snapshot.
setup_first_attempt.stage: Read-only hardware metadata after source snapshot and Rust target configuration completed

strategy: Combined target-cpu=native plus instrumentation PGO on current aaef production source; standard control and candidate both use two workers. No separate CPU-only/PGO-only or additive gain is claimed.
